# post_json_body — POST with JSON body carrying a time-window query, offset pagination
# Boots the post_json_body scenario, runs one drain (3 pages: 2+2+1 events), and
# asserts the trace and events match the golden.
# The spec is loaded live from the embedded template.

exec skopos template show -o spec.yml post_json_body
replace spec.yml http://localhost:9999 $URL
exec skopos run -i spec.yml --once --trace trace.jsonl --out events.jsonl
normalize trace.jsonl
cmp trace.jsonl want_trace.jsonl
cmp events.jsonl want_events.jsonl

-- want_trace.jsonl --
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":1,"method":"POST","request_body":"body 63 bytes, object-like","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>","Content-Type":"application/json"},"response_body":"body 357 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/post_json_body/search"}
{"elapsed":"<scrubbed>","iteration":2,"method":"POST","request_body":"body 129 bytes, object-like","request_headers":{"Accept":"application/json, application/x-ndjson;q=0.9, */*;q=0.1","Authorization":"<redacted>","Content-Type":"application/json"},"response_body":"body 25 bytes, object-like","started_at":"<scrubbed>","status":200,"url":"$URL_HOST/post_json_body/search"}
-- want_events.jsonl --
